body:
Github actions is switching `ubuntu-latest` to Ubuntu 26.04. The version of postgres included has changed, and [this causes CI to fail](https://github.com/openstreetmap/openstreetmap-website/actions/runs/40709796054/job/122894941052), e.g.

```
 CREATE TABLE public.ways (
-    way_id bigint NOT NULL,
-    changeset_id bigint NOT NULL,
+    way_id bigint CONSTRAINT ways_id_not_null NOT NULL,
+    changeset_id bigint CONSTRAINT ways_user_id_not_null NOT NULL,
     "timestamp" timestamp without time zone NOT NULL,
     version bigint NOT NULL,
     visible boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
Error: Process completed with exit code 1.
```

In #5692 (and #6785) we switched to `ubuntu-latest` and haven't really had many problems. My "github flavoured ubuntu" comments still stand, since CI uses so many packages that are not from upstream Ubuntu at all.

We can do one of the following:
* Unpick #5962 and #6785 and switch back to specific Ubuntu releases, bumping them from time to time
* Update the database structure check, to tolerate the differences between postgresql versions
* Pin the postgresql version, either by using a specific ppa or by moving to using a service container
note: Mirror of upstream issue #7544 as fetched on 2026-10-31; body may have been edited after the cases cutoffs
title: CI fails on Ubuntu 26.04 runners
